description: Amending the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act, No.38 of 2009
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health has been established by the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act, No. 38 of 2009, with the aim of formulating a national policy to set standards for occupational safety and health. Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑03‑07 to amend the said Act to expand the functions of the said Institute and establish an occupational safety and health culture that aligns with the current world of work. The Legal Draftsman has informed to obtain policy approval of the present Cabinet in order to proceed with the draft prepared for the purpose. Further, the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health has observed the need to introduce further appropriate amendments to the said Bill enabling to formulate a mechanism which is monitored by the Public sector to improve the occupational safety of employees in the sectors not covered by the Factories Ordinance and to standardize professionals engaged in the field of occupational safety and health. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to prepare the final Bill to amend the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act, incorporating the said amendments, the Cabinet decided to grant approval to proceed with the same.
